import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Evacuation {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD_REAC = -3;
    static final int CAPS = ROOM;

    static class Aresta {
        int from, to, rev, flow, cap;
        Aresta(int from, int to, int rev, int flow, int cap) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
        int residuo() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static class EdmondsKarp {
        int size;
        List<Aresta>[] grafo;
        Aresta[] prev;
        boolean[] vis;

        EdmondsKarp(int tam) {
            size = tam;
            grafo = new ArrayList[size];
            for (int i=0; i<size; i++) {
                grafo[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            prev = new Aresta[size];
            vis = new boolean[size];
        }

        void limpa() {
            for (int i=0; i<size; i++){
                grafo[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void add(int s, int t, int cap){
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, 0);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        void undirectedAdd(int s, int t, int cap){
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, cap);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int source, int sink){
            Arrays.fill(prev, null);
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Queue<Integer> fila = new LinkedList<>();
            fila.offer(source);
            vis[source] = true;
            while (!fila.isEmpty()){
                int atual = fila.poll();
                if (atual == sink) return true;
                for (Aresta a : grafo[atual]){
                    if (!vis[a.to] && a.residuo() > 0){
                        prev[a.to] = a;
                        vis[a.to] = true;
                        fila.offer(a.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int dfs(int source, int sink){
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            int v = sink;
            while (v != source){
                flow = Math.min(flow, prev[v].residuo());
                v = prev[v].from;
            }
            v = sink;
            while (v != source){
                Aresta a = prev[v];
                a.flow += flow;
                grafo[a.to].get(a.rev).flow -= flow;
                v = a.from;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        long flow(int source, int sink){
            long totalFlow = 0;
            while (bfs(source, sink)){
                totalFlow += dfs(source, sink);
            }
            return totalFlow;
        }
    }

    static int[][] station = new int[MAXN][MAXN], checkpoint = new int[MAXN][MAXN], veneno = new int[61][MAXN][MAXN];
    static List<Coord> pessoas = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Coord> capsulas = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] moveX = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] moveY = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static class Coord {
        int x, y, qtd;
        Coord(int a, int b, int c){x = a; y = b; qtd = c;}
        boolean isValid(int N){ return (x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && station[x][y] == ROOM); }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o){
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Coord)) return false;
            Coord b = (Coord) o;
            return this.x == b.x && this.y == b.y;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(x, y);
        }
    }

    static int trad(char ch){
        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') return ROOM;
        if (ch == 'Y') return REAC;
        if (ch == 'Z') return BAD_REAC;
        return -1;
    }

    static int how_much(char ch){
        return ch - '0';
    }

    static int bfs(Coord from, Coord to, int N){
        boolean[][] vis = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
        Queue<Pair> fila = new LinkedList<>();
        fila.offer(new Pair(0, from));
        vis[from.x][from.y] = true;

        while (!fila.isEmpty()){
            Pair p = fila.poll();
            int tempo = p.first;
            Coord atual = p.second;
            if (atual.equals(to)) return tempo;
            if (veneno[tempo][atual.x][atual.y] != 0) continue;

            for (int i=0; i<4; i++){
                Coord next = new Coord(atual.x + moveX[i], atual.y + moveY[i], 0);
                if (next.isValid(N) && !vis[next.x][next.y]){
                    if (veneno[tempo][next.x][next.y] == 0){
                        fila.offer(new Pair(tempo + 1, next));
                        vis[next.x][next.y] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static void espalhaVeneno(int x, int y, int T, int N){
        veneno[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int i=1; i<=T; i++){
            for (int lin=0; lin<N; lin++){
                for (int col=0; col<N; col++){
                    if (veneno[i-1][lin][col] == 1){
                        veneno[i][lin][col] = 1;
                        for (int move=0; move<4; move++){
                            int nx = lin + moveX[move];
                            int ny = col + moveY[move];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N){
                                veneno[i][nx][ny] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first;
        Coord second;
        Pair(int first, Coord second){ this.first = first; this.second = second; }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        Coord bad = new Coord(0, 0, 0);

        for (int i=0; i<N; i++){
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j<N; j++){
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int val = trad(ch);
                station[i][j] = val;
                if (val == ROOM && how_much(ch) > 0){
                    pessoas.add(new Coord(i, j, how_much(ch)));
                }
                if (val == BAD_REAC){
                    bad = new Coord(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i<N; i++){
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j<N; j++){
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int val = trad(ch);
                if (val == CAPS && how_much(ch) > 0){
                    capsulas.add(new Coord(i, j, how_much(ch)));
                    checkpoint[i][j] = how_much(ch);
                }
            }
        }

        EdmondsKarp din = new EdmondsKarp(MAXN);
        int sink = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i=0; i<pessoas.size(); i++){
            din.add(0, i*2+1, pessoas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        for (int i=0; i<capsulas.size(); i++){
            din.add(i*2+2, sink, capsulas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        espalhaVeneno(bad.x, bad.y, T, N);

        for (int i=0; i<pessoas.size(); i++){
            for (int j=0; j<capsulas.size(); j++){
                int tempo = bfs(pessoas.get(i), capsulas.get(j), N);
                if (tempo <= T){
                    din.add(i*2+1, j*2+2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(din.flow(0, sink));
    }
}
